verifier: blind Claude agent re-implementation from the brief only; comparison computed by compare_independent.py (agent verification, not human)
ambiguities: Window season filter applied literally as season >= S-1 (no upper bound); together with avail < d this effectively means seasons S-1 and S.
League shares lb/lp use ALL PAs of season S-1 from kept games, with no avail/date restriction.
Pitching set is not restricted to inning 1: any PA with is_start true and bf_i <= 9 whose fielding team is the opponent.
q(c) divides by lb(c) (batting league share), not lp(c), exactly as written; then normalized over six classes.
bf_i ordering by ab uses a stable sort (ties broken by play order); counted only among PAs (skipped plays excluded).
is_start false when the fielding team's starter (box pitchers[0]) is missing.
Chain: P(no run) is computed by exact recursion over (outs, bases) states; any transition that scores a run is a failure (W with bases loaded, S1 with runner on 3rd, XB with any runner, any HR).
Event-prefix skip uses str.startswith, so e.g. pickoff_caught_stealing_* and pickoff_error_* are skipped; sac_bunt_double_play, triple_play, etc. are class O.

Game keep requires game.type, status.codedGameState, pk, game.season, datetime.officialDate, teams.home.id, teams.away.id and plays; linescore/box are optional (not needed for these columns). All 12,359 files passed; no duplicate pks found.
Dates compared as calendar days (YYYY-MM-DD); avail = resumeDate when present and non-empty.
